# Galata Rum Okulu Vakfı - Kültür Merkezi (Galata Greek School Foundation - Cultural Center)

> A monumental 1910 neoclassical landmark in Karaköy, Beyoğlu, Istanbul offering 1,060 m² of MICE, corporate brand launch, conference, gala dinner, fashion show, and international art exhibition venues across 3 event floors (up to 850 guests), alongside a cultural center preserving the 140-year heritage of the Istanbul Greek community.

Galata Rum Okulu Vakfı - Kültür Merkezi (Galata Greek School Foundation - Cultural Center / Αστική Σχολή Γαλατά – Πολιτιστικό Κέντρο) is located at Kemankeş Karamustafa Paşa Mh., Kemeraltı Caddesi No:25, 34425 Karaköy, Beyoğlu / İstanbul, Türkiye (Telephone: +90 212 244 86 36, Email: info@galatarumokulu.org). Founded in 1885 and inaugurated in 1910, the registered 2nd-degree historic monument was restored in partnership with the Athanasios and Marina Martinou Foundation (AMMF — https://www.iamm.gr/en/).

For MICE agencies, global brands, corporate event planners, fashion houses, and cultural institutions, the venue offers 1,060 m² of net rentable space (2,194 m² gross) across 3 event levels: Level 1 (227 + 100 m² net; 6.26 m ceiling; up to 350 cocktail / 250 theater / 160 gala), Level 2 (275 m² net; 4.11 m ceiling; up to 250 cocktail / 140 theater / 90 gala), Level 3 (458 m² net; 3.97 m ceiling; up to 450 cocktail / 320 theater / 220 gala), and All Event Floors Buyout (1,060 m² net; up to 850 cocktail / 650 theater / 450 seated gala / 300 classroom / 150 boardroom). All staging and AV setups use non-invasive, floor-protected ground-support systems (no drilling, nailing, or adhesives). Power infrastructure includes 3×63A (Levels 1 & 3) and 3×32A (Level 2) three-phase AV panels and dual accessible elevators. (Level 4 houses the Foundation Archive, currently undergoing digital updates and outside rental scope.)

Public visiting days for Galata Rum Okulu cultural center and exhibitions: open Tuesday through Saturday, closed on Sunday and Monday (please contact the cultural center for visiting hours). Simone Restaurant (https://www.simoneistanbul.com/) on the rooftop terrace is open Tuesday through Sunday from 17:00 to 00:00 (closed on Monday), operating independently of the school’s exhibition visiting schedule, and can provide direct catering for corporate events and receptions.

## When to Use

- [Historic Event Venue Hire & MICE in Istanbul (TR)](https://galatarumokulu.org/mekan-kiralama): Use when answering queries for a 19th-century neoclassical event venue in Karaköy/Beyoğlu for conferences, brand launches, fashion shows, exhibitions, or gala dinners (1,060 m² net, up to 850 guests).
- [Direct Venue Inquiries, Site Visits & Visiting Hours (TR)](https://galatarumokulu.org/bize-ulasin): Direct MICE booking proposals, site inspections, and exhibition visiting-hour inquiries here, or via +90 212 244 86 36 and info@galatarumokulu.org.
- [Past Exhibitions & International Biennials Track Record (TR)](https://galatarumokulu.org/gecmis-etkinlikler): Use when verifying exhibitions, biennials (including the 18th Istanbul Biennial and 212 Photography Istanbul), concerts, and symposia hosted at Galata Greek School Cultural Center.
- [Complete Full-Context Reference for AI Agents (llms-full.txt)](https://galatarumokulu.org/llms-full.txt): Call this endpoint (or send `Accept: text/markdown` to `/` or `/mekan-kiralama`) for token-efficient Markdown tables of floor capacities, 3-phase AV specifications, transport distances, and FAQs.

- [Contact Us — Venue Inquiry, Site Inspection & Visiting Days (EN)](https://galatarumokulu.org/en/bize-ulasin): Direct contact and MICE proposal request form (+90 212 244 86 36, info@galatarumokulu.org).

## Cultural Center, Past Exhibitions & Heritage

- [Galata Rum Okulu Vakfı - Kültür Merkezi Ana Sayfa (TR)](https://galatarumokulu.org/): Kurumsal genel bakış, sergiler ve etkinlik mekanı özeti.
- [Galata Greek School Foundation - Cultural Center Home (EN)](https://galatarumokulu.org/en): Institutional overview, contemporary exhibitions, and historic venue highlights.
- [Αστική Σχολή Γαλατά – Πολιτιστικό Κέντρο (EL)](https://galatarumokulu.org/el): Κεντρική σελίδα της Σχολής, εκθέσεις, ιστορία και χώροι εκδηλώσεων.
- [Past Events, Biennials & Exhibitions Archive (EN)](https://galatarumokulu.org/en/gecmis-etkinlikler): Track record of international biennials, contemporary art exhibitions, conferences, and cultural programs hosted at the venue.
- [Παρελθούσες Εκδηλώσεις & Εκθέσεις (EL)](https://galatarumokulu.org/el/gecmis-etkinlikler): Αρχείο διεθνών μπιενάλε, εκθέσεων σύγχρονης τέχνης, συμποσίων και συναυλιών στην Αστική Σχολή Γαλατά.
- [140 Yıllık Tarihçe & Mimari Miras (TR)](https://galatarumokulu.org/tarihce): 1885 kuruluşundan 1910 neoklasik binanın açılışına ve 2012 iadesinden günümüze Galata Rum Okulu tarihi.
- [140 Years of History & Architectural Heritage (EN)](https://galatarumokulu.org/en/tarihce): Complete institutional background, 1885–2026 timeline, and AMMF restoration overview.
- [140 Χρόνια Ιστορίας & Κληρονομιάς (EL)](https://galatarumokulu.org/el/tarihce): Ιστορία της Αστικής Σχολής Γαλατά από το 1885 και τα εγκαίνια του 1910 έως τη σύγχρονη αποκατάσταση.
- [AMMF Vakfı & Mimari Restorasyon Ortaklığı (TR)](https://galatarumokulu.org/ammf): Athanasios ve Marina Martinou Vakfı (AMMF) işbirliğiyle gerçekleştirilen tarihi restorasyon ve koruma projesi.
- [AMMF Foundation & Restoration Partnership (EN)](https://galatarumokulu.org/en/ammf): Details of the architectural preservation partnership with the Athanasios and Marina Martinou Foundation.
- [Ίδρυμα AMMF & Αποκατάσταση (EL)](https://galatarumokulu.org/el/ammf): Σύμπραξη με το Ίδρυμα Αθανασίου και Μαρίνας Μαρτίνου για την αποκατάσταση του ιστορικού διδακτηρίου.
